requirements.name: stack-go-module
requirements.text: Implement in Go 1.22 or newer using only the standard library. The application root is a Go module, and its executable is the main package at `./cmd/ddkstat`. Tests run under `go test`.

requirements.name: read-json-lines-log
requirements.text: The log is JSON Lines in UTF-8: one JSON object per line.

requirements.name: blank-lines-ignored
requirements.text: Blank lines are ignored and not counted.

requirements.name: command-syntax
requirements.text: `<report>` comes first, options follow it, and the log path is last. Exactly one log path is required.

requirements.name: usage-errors-exit-2
requirements.text: Usage error: unknown report or option, missing option value, invalid date, missing or extra log path.

requirements.name: unreadable-log-exit-1
requirements.text: Operational failure: the log cannot be opened or read.

requirements.name: failing-command-output
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: success-exit-0
requirements.text: Success, including a log with skipped lines or no matching records.

requirements.name: target-filter
requirements.text: Keep only records whose `job.target` equals `<name>` exactly.

requirements.name: date-filters
requirements.text: Keep only records whose start date is on or after `<date>`. Keep only records whose start date is on or before `<date>`. A date option must be a real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`.

requirements.name: filters-apply-to-every-report
requirements.text: Filters apply to every report.

requirements.name: skip-malformed-and-duplicate-lines
requirements.text: A line is skipped when it is not a JSON object, when any of `execution_id`, `started_at`, `status`, `job.command_name`, or `job.target` is absent or not a non-empty string, or when its `execution_id` already appeared on an earlier line. The first occurrence of an `execution_id` is kept.

requirements.name: skip-warning
requirements.text: Each skipped line writes one warning to standard error naming its line number. Skipping never changes the exit code.

requirements.name: summary-skipped-count-whole-file
requirements.text: The `skipped` count in `summary` counts skipped lines in the whole file regardless of filters.

requirements.name: zero-fill-missing-numbers
requirements.text: An absent or `null` token count, cost, or duration counts as zero. A record with no `result.stats` object at all is still a record.

requirements.name: failed-status
requirements.text: A record is failed when `status` is not `succeeded`.

requirements.name: model-attribution
requirements.text: A record's model is `result.stats.model` when present and non-empty, otherwise `job.model`.

requirements.name: minutes-column
requirements.text: A minutes column is the group's summed `elapsed_ms` written in tenths of a minute: `t = (ms + 3000) / 6000` in integer division, written as `t / 10`, a `.`, and `t % 10`. `95000` ms is `1.6`.

requirements.name: cost-column
requirements.text: A cost column is the group's summed `cost_usd` written with exactly four decimal places, as Go's `%.4f` writes a `float64`.

requirements.name: csv-output
requirements.text: Every report writes CSV to standard output: one header row, then data rows, comma-separated, `\n` line endings.

requirements.name: total-row
requirements.text: Every report except `summary` and `failures` ends with a `TOTAL` row over all filtered records.

requirements.name: byte-order-text
requirements.text: Text is compared by byte value.

requirements.name: summary-report
requirements.text: `first` and `last` are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when no record matches.

requirements.name: commands-report
requirements.text: One per command, by calls descending, then command ascending. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: targets-report
requirements.text: One per Target, by Target ascending. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: models-report
requirements.text: One per provider and model pair, by provider then model ascending. Then `TOTAL,,…`.

requirements.name: daily-report
requirements.text: One per start date, ascending. `tokens` is input plus cached plus output.

requirements.name: failures-report
requirements.text: One per failed record, by `started_at` then `execution_id` ascending. `returncode` is empty when `null` or absent. `timed_out` is `true` or `false`.

requirements.name: empty-match-output
requirements.text: When no record matches, a report writes its header and, where it has one, a `TOTAL` row of zeros (`0.0` minutes, `0.0000` cost).

requirements.name: test-launcher
requirements.text: The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` from the application root and exits zero only when both pass.

requirements.name: test-coverage
requirements.text: The suite covers each report, each filter, each skip rule, and each exit code using logs written by the tests.

requirements.name: harness-build-and-checks
requirements.text: The harness runs `go build -o <temporary path> ./cmd/ddkstat` and then runs 20 checks against `sources/llm_sample.jsonl`.

requirements.name: grader-score
requirements.text: `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/run.sh` from the completed application root and takes its exit code and output as the score.

requirements.name: build-ddkstat-from-cmd
requirements.text: Builds ./cmd/ddkstat with `go build` and compares every report's exit code and standard output over the supplied sample log with the known answer below.

requirements.name: exact-report-stdout
requirements.text: compares every report's exit code and standard output over the supplied sample log with the known answer below. Standard error is never compared.

requirements.name: summary-report
requirements.text: check A1 0 summary "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: commands-report
requirements.text: check A2 0 commands "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: targets-report
requirements.text: check A3 0 targets "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: models-report
requirements.text: check A4 0 models "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: daily-report
requirements.text: check A5 0 daily "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: failures-report
requirements.text: check A6 0 failures "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: records-skipped-count
requirements.text: records,skipped,succeeded,failed,first,last,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes

requirements.name: filter-by-target
requirements.text: check B4 0 failures --target CommonMark "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: filter-by-date-range
requirements.text: check B3 0 daily --since 2026-10-15 --until 2026-10-15 "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: empty-match-reports
requirements.text: A filter that matches nothing

requirements.name: missing-log-exit-1
requirements.text: check E1 1 summary "$MISSING" < /dev/null

requirements.name: usage-errors-exit-2
requirements.text: Usage errors

requirements.name: grader-gate
requirements.text: Exit 0 only when the build succeeds and every check passes.
